settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Shown in the home header at 32×32. Leave empty to use the bundled OKA mark.

settings.label: Default language
settings.info: The app opens in Arabic. Shoppers can switch at any time; their choice is remembered.

settings.label: Ask shoppers to confirm they are 18+
settings.info: Parts of the catalogue are tobacco products.

settings.label: Collections
settings.info: In order. These drive the home feed, the categories list, search, the edit-order sheet and the subscription builder — the app's CATS list.

settings.content: Estimates shown before checkout (cart bar, product page). Shopify's checkout always charges the store's own rate. Mirrors server/config/zones.js.

settings.label: Cairo, Giza, Alexandria — at or over threshold
Delta & Canal — at or over threshold
Upper Egypt, Sinai, Red Sea… — under threshold
Upper Egypt, Sinai, Red Sea… — at or over threshold
Minimum order (EGP)
settings.info: 0 turns it off. The checkout button stays disabled below it.

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: International format, e.g. 201001234567. Powers the support button and order-change requests.

settings.label: Courier tracking page
settings.info: Used when a shipment has a tracking number but no tracking link (J&T's fulfillments arrive without one). Put {number} where the AWB goes, e.g. https://example.com/track?awb={number}. Without {number}, the button copies the AWB and opens the page.

settings.content: Order edit and cancel, live courier tracking, loyalty redemption and Subscribe & Save run on the OKA order service. Connect it through a Shopify App Proxy and enter the proxy path here (for example /apps/oka). Leave empty and those screens fall back to WhatsApp and Shopify's own account pages.
Lets signed-in customers change the delivery address or cancel an order until the courier picks it up. The key can only reach those customer actions, so it is safe in the page.

settings.label: Let customers change items
settings.info: Adds "Change items" (remove, change quantities, add products) next to Change address, sent to the orders API as customer_edit_items. Turn on once the API has that action.

settings.label: Ask delivered orders for a rating
settings.info: 5 stars and a comment on each delivered order, sent to the orders API as customer_rate_order. Turn on once the API has that action.

settings.label: Order service URL (without an App proxy)
settings.info: Lets signed-in customers edit and cancel unshipped orders, see points and more. Needs the key below.

settings.label: Storefront key
settings.info: The order service's STOREFRONT_TOKEN_SECRET (32+ characters). Never shown to shoppers — the page only carries a signature made with it.

settings.content: Signed-in customers see each shipped order's live J&T scans and the courier's Call / WhatsApp, read straight from OKA's website tracking service (jt-mcp-website on Cloud Run). Its key can only track parcels, so it is safe in the page.

settings.label: Tracking service key
settings.info: The website key (WEBSITE_AUTH_TOKEN). Tracking only — it cannot create or cancel shipments.

settings.label: J&T lookup panel (staff testing)
settings.info: Adds a box to the Orders page that finds a customer's J&T shipments by phone, or tracks AWB numbers, through the tracking service above. Turn it off before publishing.
